requirement.text: The system shall provide handicap access.

initial_eus.title: Accessibility for Users with Disabilities
initial_eus.description: As a user with a disability, I want to be able to access the system, so that I can use it despite my impairment.
work_items: The system shall be accessible to users with disabilities.

analysis.ethical_objective: Ensure accessibility of the system for people with disabilities so that they are not excluded from using it.

obligations.text: The system shall be accessible to users with disabilities.
obligations.source_span: The system shall provide handicap access.

constraints: Applies to the system as a whole; no scope, context, or type of disability is specified.
ambiguities: "Handicap access" is not defined; it is unclear which disabilities (e.g., visual, auditory, motor, cognitive) or which aspects of the system are in scope.
No accessibility standard, level of conformance, or acceptance criterion is specified.
It is unclear whether "access" refers to the user interface, physical access to hardware, or both.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume compliance with a specific accessibility standard or law (e.g., WCAG, ADA).
Do not assume specific assistive technologies or mechanisms (e.g., screen readers, keyboard navigation).
Do not assume a particular set of disabilities or a conformance level.
Do not assume testing procedures, thresholds, or timing.
Do not infer additional stakeholder benefits beyond enabling access.
possible_operational_aspects: Accessibility must be provided by the system itself for users with disabilities.

work_items.explanation: The work item restates O1 directly: the system shall be accessible to users with disabilities, corresponding to the source requirement to provide handicap access.
